interpretation_boundary: This file reports weather drivers and weather event risk. It does not produce a final autumn-colour or phenology conclusion.

forecast_16_35d.interpretation: 16-35 day background signal only; not a date-level forecast or phenology lead/lag calculation

gfs_crosscheck.interpretation: cross-check only; HRES and GFS are not averaged

leaf_loss_weather_risk.interpretation: weather event risk only; it does not determine whether leaves fall
